note: This file classifies rules used during the 2026-09-03 reproduction audit. Nothing listed as PROPOSED or EXPERIMENTAL is frozen by this audit.

preexisting_frozen_portfolio_rules.rule: E16 core allocation, E18/E22 execution, E44 Exact T+1 clock, E45 crisis protection, PIT, walk-forward, embargo, no 0050 leveraged ETF in core

preexisting_research_gates_not_frozen_by.rule: R1 average daily turnover ceiling 2.5% on 2011-2018 OOF
R1 promotion requires both 2019-2022 and 2023-latest CAGR above PIT market proxy after costs
R1 promotion requires 21-session block-bootstrap positive-excess probability >= 0.70 on both held-out windows
R1 model/portfolio selection uses embargoed 2011-2018 OOF only; utility = CAGR - 0.5*|MDD|
R1 search grid: top_k {20,30}, rebalance {5,10,21}, exit_multiple {1.25,1.5,2.0}, neutralization {NONE,INDUSTRY_LIQUIDITY}, industry_cap {3,5}
A3 promotion requires validation and sealed CAGR > 0 and bootstrap >= 0.70 (does not require beating market proxy)
A3 cost assumptions: buy 14.25bp, sell 14.25bp, tax 30bp, 5bp slippage each side; min trading_money NT$20m; equal-weight long-only
preexisting_research_gates_not_frozen_by.note: E18/E22 is the frozen execution layer. These A3 sleeve costs are research assumptions inside the overlay simulator, not a new freeze.

preexisting_research_gates_not_frozen_by.rule: Do not apply E45 inside A3/R1; E45 handoff is deferred until a later gate
preexisting_research_gates_not_frozen_by.note: E45 itself is FROZEN as crisis core. The deferral of overlay-to-E45 integration is existing R1 research policy.

introduced_by_this_audit.rule: Hidden-leverage diagnostic: count days with gross exposure > 1.001
introduced_by_this_audit.use: audit diagnostic only; observed 0 days in reproduced R1 NAV

introduced_by_this_audit.rule: Reproduction success includes SHA-256 match of pinned A0/A2 QC file hashes and byte-match of A3/R1 period_metrics/daily_nav/trades versus CI
introduced_by_this_audit.note: Pinned run IDs already existed in A3/R1 workflows. Using hash/byte match as the audit pass criterion is new to this audit.

introduced_by_this_audit.rule: Next challenger may inspect turnover even on rebalance intervals or buffers outside the current R1 grid
introduced_by_this_audit.note: Not implemented. Current R1 grid already includes rebalance 21 and exit_multiple 2.0. Expanding the grid is a proposed experiment, not a selected rule.
